# Keep the Light 1.47.0

- **Start menu shortcut:** the first time the window opens, Keep the Light adds itself to your Start menu (no installer needed). Add or remove it under ⚙ Settings → Start menu. After unzipping a new version elsewhere, the shortcut follows the copy you open.
- **Working locally with network files:** the thorough check and the Plex check now run on this PC before the result is copied back, and the copy on the network drive is checked to match exactly (copied again if it does not).
